problem_statement: When Fast Start Mode is active on the SRP server, enabling the auto-enable mode does not turn Fast Start Mode off. Enabling auto-enable mode while Fast Start Mode is active should stop the SRP server, clear the Fast Start Mode flag, restore the address mode to its previous setting, and leave the server in the disabled state so that attempting to enable Fast Start Mode again is rejected.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
